reason: A proposes a more physically credible, load-bearing intervention: a metallurgically bonded laser-clad layer with in situ ceramic reinforcement can plausibly improve hardness and wear resistance at elevated temperature, and its phase formation, adhesion, hardness, and wear response are directly falsifiable. B relies on a thin, brittle ALD Al2O3 film with an inadequately supported grain-boundary-strengthening claim, unspecified thickness and temperature limits, and evidence that does not directly validate ALD Al2O3 durability under cyclic thermomechanical loading.
